notes.title: Update 2.1.0 - Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
- Limit the number of messages visible in the terminal (300).
- Added pagination to commands-view when more than 100 commands. 
- Improved performance of game state updates.

notes.title: Update 2.0 - New Commands
notes.notes: [h3]New commands[/h3][list][*][p]cut: Slices an element into multiple smaller elements (e.g., A -> 3x (A)). Works also as an inverse operation for pack.[/p][/*][*][p]separate: Splits merged elements into their individual components.[/p][/*][*][p]trash: Deletes a single copy of an element from the storage.[/p][/*][*][p]morph: An alternative crafting command that transforms a recipe element into a result element, from where the base element is extracted using the cut, separate, and trash commands.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Changes[/h3][list][*][p]UI/UX changes[/p][/*][*][p]Changed possible elements view into options - command[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 - QoL Changes
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES v1.0.6

[list]
[*] Fixed the problem, where users were not able to load a leaderboard if they did not have an entry in the leaderboard.
[*] Added filter buttons to storage view (For elements consisting of A, B, C etc.) (These buttons become visible when there are at least two elements consisting of different letters.)
[*] Keep the focus on the input console.
[*] Added ability to change font sizes separately on different views (commands, storage, log, recipes/possible)
[*] Reversed commands on command view (Newest on top)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - UI Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes v1.0.5 [/b]

[list]
[*] Increased font size in the input console
[*] Added syntax coloring for the input console
[*] Improved font colors and sizes for elements in storage-view and in recipes-view
[*] Renamed "previous commands"-upgrade into "arrow keys"-upgrade and added indicator icon into input console, when this feature is active. 
[*] Moved commands-view to separate window
[*] Added syntax coloring to commands-view
[*] Improved responsivity of UI
[*] Small adjustments to console log printing
[/list]
